lite lynx model only includes ip adapter for face id.

full lynx model also includes reference adapter, which works by first running your reference image through the model for 1 step, and the main inference then uses those extracted values on each step.

The reference adapter feels extremely strong and usually reducing it's strength or limiting the blocks it is applied to helps avoid that

Model links:

[https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy_fp8_scaled/tree/main/](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/WanVideo_comfy_fp8_scaled/tree/main/)

Original implementation uses full ip layers with full ref layers, I don't know if there's some mistake in my implementation as the full ip adapter seems very weak, and using lite ip instead seems better, and also uses less memory.
色调艳丽，过曝，静态，细节模糊不清，字幕，风格，作品，画作，画面，静止，整体发灰，最差质量，低质量，JPEG压缩残留，丑陋的，残缺的，多余的手指，画得不好的手部，画得不好的脸部，畸形的，毁容的，形态畸形的肢体，手指融合，静止不动的画面，杂乱的背景，三条腿，背景人很多，倒着走

Original code and this node uses insightface only to crop the image, you can use other crop automatic face croppers or manually crop the face for the ip_image as well. The image is tiny 112x112

While InsightFace code is MIT licensed, the Buffalo -model used has strictly "non-commercial research purposes only" -license

For the actual encoding Arcface model is used, I couldn't find clear answer to what it's license is.

For the reference the original code uses different slightly more zoomed out cropping  for 256x256 input image, you can do this manually as well.

Sunlight poured down from above, illuminating the slender figure poised on the diving platform. The girl stood at the edge, arms slightly open, toes gripping the rough surface beneath her. A cool breeze brushed past her ears, carrying the scent of water. She took a deep breath, her shoulders trembling slightly, eyes fixed on the calm blue below.
In the next heartbeat, her body left the platform, tracing a graceful arc through the air. Time seemed to stretch—she spun and reached out, like a bird lifted by light. Then came a clean, sharp splash as she cut into the water, the surface bursting into a brief shimmer before settling again. The pool grew still once more, ripples spreading softly, glinting under the sun.
